about: The primitive matrix (learn.matrix): one row for each way a page moves a value or changes state. ceiling is the highest rung (learn.rung) a call of the row may reach; person marks a row only a person can pass.

rows.what: the caller's value goes straight into the call's address
a token in the page's own HTML, good for this visitor only
a token the page asks for once and keeps in its storage
the caller's value inside a JSON value of the address
the caller's value inside JSON that is encoded again
the caller's value is looked up, and the search sends the id that came back
a header hashed from the clock and the value with a standard hash
a header made by a function of the site's own

after two values agree, a value the site holds nothing for is answered with the results page all the same: an empty list beside the site's copy and filters, the value named in the page's words

a search that reads the caller's value word by word: its records say the value's words, seldom the value whole, and nothing says the ask back: its records say it back
